Card Q&A.a: Yes, it's returned. In such cases, only the top card is returned to the hand and all digivolution cards are trashed.
Card Q&A.q: The Digimon played using this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect digivolved. Is that Digimon returned to the hand at the end of my opponent's turn?

Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn’t activate. The rest of the effect won't activate if you don't perform the specified action in effects with "by X" conditions.
Card Q&A.q: When one of my Digimon DNA digivolves into a blue or green Digimon, does the "trash any 3 digivolution cards under your opponent's Digimon" effect activate even if I don't suspend this Tamer?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] You may play 1 [Veemon] or [Wormmon] from your hand without paying the cost. At your opponent’s next turn end, return it to the hand.

[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon digivolve into a blue or green Digimon, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory. Then, if DNA digivolving, trash any 3 digivolution cards from your opponent's Digimon.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
